tasks.ask: A story of 4 to 6 short sentences on a book theme, then five questions (2 recall, 2 understand, 1 apply), one mark each, with answers.
tasks.instruction_en: Read the short story aloud twice. Then ask the questions; the child answers aloud.
tasks.instruction_ur: مختصر کہانی دو بار بلند آواز سے پڑھیں، پھر سوال پوچھیں؛ بچہ زبانی جواب دے۔

tasks.ask: One topic a Grade 1 child knows (my family, my school, my favourite food), with three prompt questions.

rubric.en: Says three or more things about the topic
rubric.ur: موضوع پر تین یا زیادہ باتیں

rubric.en: Uses English words and short sentences

tasks.instruction_en: Ask the child to talk about the topic for about a minute. Prompt with the questions if they stop.
tasks.instruction_ur: بچے سے موضوع پر تقریباً ایک منٹ بات کرنے کو کہیں۔ رک جائے تو سوالوں سے مدد کریں۔

tasks.ask: Six simple book words (three-letter and sight words) printed large for the child to read.
tasks.instruction_en: Point to each word in turn. The child reads it aloud. One mark per word read right.
tasks.instruction_ur: ہر لفظ پر باری باری انگلی رکھیں۔ بچہ اسے بلند آواز سے پڑھے۔ ہر درست لفظ پر 1 نمبر۔

items.ask: Who does Pinky see helping Dadi?
What does Dani give Dadi to help her hear?
What else does Dani give Dadi?
How do you help someone at home?
items.answer: Any answer about helping at home, such as I help my mother.

content.script: Pinky comes to play. She sees Dani helping Dadi. Pinky greets Dadi. Dadi cannot hear her. Dani gives Dadi a hearing aid. He also gives her glasses.

items.ask: What is your name and how old are you?
items.answer: Child says own name and age, such as My name is Ali. I am 6 years old.

items.ask: Who do you live with in your family?
items.answer: Child names people in own family.

items.ask: What do you like to do?
items.answer: Child says something they like, such as I like to paint.

oral.note_en: Take the oral part after the written paper, one child at a time. Read the script aloud as written.
